title: The GOP Is Now ‘An Extremist Movement,’ Says Ex-Republican Strategist
author: John Harwood
content:
It's a bizarre timeline: ICE murders, endless wars, the Epstein files, and a
president hellbent on staying in power. The worst part? The entire Republican
party seems to stand behind Trump as he hauls the country toward fascism.

But, is it true? Can non-MAGA Republicans stop Trump? Is there any hint of
normalcy left in the U.S. political system, or are we doomed for autocracy?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Lincoln Square's **Stuart Stevens** , former Republican strategist and Lincoln
Project adviser, joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** to answer that question.

**" I don't think the Republican party is a traditional American political
party now. I think it's an extremist movement."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch the full, wide-ranging discussion above to hear Stevens and Harwood
perform an autopsy of American conservatism, discuss why Stevens thinks **"
race is the original sin of the modern Republican Party,"**__ and break down
what it would take for a Democrat to win the 2028 election.
